visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A gloved hand holds a large block of dark brown, glossy stewed tofu, allowing thick, dark sauce to drip back into a tray. The tofu has a porous, dense texture. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the wet surface of the food. (2) A pink frying pan sits on a gas stove with visible blue flames. The chef tosses a mixture of green broccoli, yellow corn, black fungus, and slices of meat. The motion is vigorous, showing a stir-fry process. (3) Hands in plastic gloves pour prepared ingredients from a metal funnel into a clear plastic bag resting inside a container. The ingredients include cooked meat, tofu, and vegetables. (4) An outdoor food stall view at twilight shows a male vendor in a blue floral shirt and purple mask. Several customers stand around the stall, which features glass displays filled with various stewed items. (5) Close-up of the cooking process where garlic and sliced white onions are sizzled in a black wok. Fresh green basil leaves are then added, followed by the stewed ingredients and a splash of red chili sauce. (6) A sequence of close-ups shows different food items being lifted with wooden chopsticks: dark rice blood cake, thin layers of bean curd skin, a yellowish chicken claw, slices of pork ear, and pieces of pork neck meat. The backgrounds are either the plastic food bag or a small dipping bowl of red chili sauce.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional food review for a specific 'Lu Wei' stall in Kaohsiung. It highlights the unique selling point of offering both cold and hot stir-fried versions of stewed food. The high-energy narration, fast-paced montage of close-up food shots, and detailed ingredient list aim to stimulate the viewer's appetite and drive traffic to the business location provided in the slogan.
